FN-J0RLFF-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 202
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Kerry Underwood
Commissions
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 03/28/2023
House Bill 202 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Polygraph Examiners Board
until October 1, 2027 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect
state or local funding.
Page 1
